updateTime.description: Timestamp of the last update of this consolidated document

session_id.description: Identifier of the DDP data-available session

time_start.description: Start time of the data availability period

time_stop.description: Stop time of the data availability period

time_created.description: Time the data was created on the interface

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service that provided the data

production_service_name.description: Name of the production service that provided the data
